fields.description: What kind of message this is. The fields below follow the type.

fields.label: Template
fields.description: Pick a saved template to copy its text and attachment into this message. Later edits to the template do not change this one.

fields.label: Body
fields.description: The text the recipient receives. Variables like {{ recipient.display_name }} are filled per recipient.

fields.label: Print Format
fields.description: Print the recipient's own document with this format and send it as a PDF.

fields.label: File Name Template
fields.description: What the file is called when it arrives, e.g. Invoice-{{ doc.name }}.pdf.

fields.label: Poll Options
fields.description: The answers, as a JSON list — at least two.

fields.label: Allow Multiple Answers
fields.description: Let the recipient pick more than one answer.

fields.label: Delay after Previous (s)
fields.description: How long to wait after the message before this one. 0 sends it straight after.
